l10_welcome:
Welcome to Level 10: Context Menu!
Right-click anywhere on the desktop wallpaper to open the options menu.
l10_wallpaperRightClickReminder: Click the right mouse button on the desktop wallpaper to open the menu!
l10_clickMenu:
Awesome! This is the Context Menu.
Click on '+ New Text Document (.txt)' or '+ New Folder' to create an item!
l10_menuClosedError: The menu closed! Right-click again on the desktop and select an option!
l10_menuSelectReminder: Click on '+ New Text Document (.txt)' or '+ New Folder' inside the menu!
l10_done: Fantastic! You've learned how to use the desktop context menu to create and customize files!
l11_openNotepad:
Level 11: Word Processing!
Double-click the Notepad icon to open the text editor.
l11_openReminder: Double-click quickly with the left mouse button on the Notepad icon to open it!
l11_typePrompt:
Now let's practice typing on your keyboard!
Click inside the page and type: 'Hello Computer!'
l11_clickInsideError: Click inside the blank notepad area first so your cursor is ready to type!
l11_partialHelloReminder: Great start! You typed 'Hello' - now add ' Computer!' to complete the phrase!
l11_typeReminder: Click inside the white page and type 'Hello Computer!' on your keyboard.
l11_done: Terrific! You typed the phrase perfectly!
l12_copyPrompt:
Let's master keyboard shortcuts!
Highlight the word 'Cat' and press Ctrl + C on your keyboard to copy it.
l12_restoreHoldCtrlC: Hold down the Ctrl key while pressing C! I brought 'Cat Dog' back so you can try again.
l12_restoreWordsCopy: Oops! We need those words to practice! I restored 'Cat Dog' for you. Highlight 'Cat' and press Ctrl + C!
l12_holdCtrlC: Remember to hold down the Ctrl key and press C at the same time to copy!
l12_copyFirstBeforePaste: You need to copy 'Cat' first with Ctrl + C before pasting!
l12_copyReminder: Drag your mouse across 'Cat' to highlight it, then hold Ctrl and press C!
l12_copyDone: Nice! 'Cat' is copied into your clipboard.
l12_pastePrompt: Now click at the end of the text and press Ctrl + V to Paste 'Cat'!
l12_restoreHoldCtrlV: Hold down the Ctrl key while pressing V! I restored 'Cat Dog' for you.
l12_restoreWordsPaste: Oops! Don't erase the words! I brought 'Cat Dog' back - just press Ctrl + V to paste!
l12_holdCtrlV: Hold down the Ctrl key and press V together to paste!
l12_alreadyCopied: 'Cat' is already copied! Now press Ctrl + V to Paste it!
l12_pasteReminder: Hold down Ctrl and press V on your keyboard to paste 'Cat'!
l12_pasteDone: You pasted it! Now you have two Cats!
l12_cutPrompt: Now highlight the word 'Dog' and press Ctrl + X to Cut it away!
l12_restoreHoldCtrlX: Hold down the Ctrl key while pressing X! I brought 'Dog' back so you can Cut it with Ctrl + X.
l12_restoreBackspaceDog: Don't erase 'Dog' with Backspace! I brought 'Cat Dog Cat' back - highlight 'Dog' and press Ctrl + X to Cut it!
l12_keepCatCutDog: Oops! Keep the 'Cat' words and only highlight 'Dog', then press Ctrl + X!
l12_holdCtrlX: Hold down Ctrl and press X together after highlighting 'Dog'!
l12_cutReminder: Highlight 'Dog' with your mouse and press Ctrl + X to cut it!
l12_done: Brilliant! Ctrl + X cut the text and saved it to your clipboard!
l13_welcome:
Welcome to Level 13!
Look at this sentence: 'Computer Science is fun!'
l13_undoPrompt:
Oh no! Someone accidentally made a mistake!
Press Ctrl + Z to Undo the mistake and restore your original words!
l13_restoreHoldCtrlZ: Hold down the Control (Ctrl) key while pressing Z! I reset the sentence for you.
l13_restoreManualErase: No need to erase it by hand! I reset the sentence - just press Ctrl + Z to fix it automatically!
l13_holdCtrlZ: Hold down the Control (Ctrl) key and press Z together!
l13_undoReminder: Hold down Ctrl and press Z on your keyboard to Undo the mistake!
l13_done: Magic! Ctrl + Z lets you undo mistakes in almost every program!
l14_saveShortcutPrompt:
Level 14: Save Shortcut!
Always save your files. Press Ctrl + S on your keyboard to save this note.
l14_restoreErasedNote: Oops! Don't erase the note before saving! I restored it - press Ctrl + S to save!
l14_holdCtrlS: Hold down Ctrl and press S together to save your document!
l14_saveReminder: Press Ctrl + S on your keyboard to open the Save window!
l14_saveModalPrompt: The Save window is open! Type a name for your file (like 'MyNotes') and click SAVE.
l14_done: Document saved! Ctrl + S is the most useful shortcut to keep your work safe.
l15_welcome:
Level 15: The Grand Word Challenge!
Let's test all your typing and keyboard skills together.
l15_step1: Step 1 of 5: Type the three colors: 'Red Blue Green'
l15_step1Reminder: Type the three words 'Red Blue Green' inside the notepad!
l15_step2: Step 2 of 5: Highlight 'Blue', press Ctrl + C to copy it, and press Ctrl + V to paste it!
l15_step2RestoreHoldCtrl: Hold down the Ctrl key while pressing C or V! I restored 'Red Blue Green' for you.
l15_step2RestoreErased: Oops! Don't erase the colors! I restored 'Red Blue Green' - highlight 'Blue', press Ctrl + C, then Ctrl + V!
l15_step2HoldCtrl: Remember to hold down the Ctrl key when pressing C to copy or V to paste!
l15_step2Reminder: Highlight 'Blue', press Ctrl + C to copy, and then press Ctrl + V to paste!
l15_step3: Step 3 of 5: Highlight 'Red' and press Ctrl + X to cut it away!
l15_step3RestoreHoldCtrlX: Hold down the Ctrl key while pressing X! I brought 'Red' back so you can Cut it.
l15_step3RestoreBackspace: Don't erase 'Red' with Backspace! I brought it back - highlight 'Red' and press Ctrl + X to Cut it!
l15_step3KeepOthers: Oops! Keep the other colors and only highlight 'Red', then press Ctrl + X!
l15_step3HoldCtrlX: Hold down Ctrl and press X together to cut 'Red'!
l15_step3Reminder: Highlight 'Red' with your mouse and press Ctrl + X!
l15_step4: Step 4 of 5: Press Ctrl + Z to Undo the cut and bring 'Red' back!
l15_step4HoldCtrlZ: Hold down Ctrl and press Z together to undo!
l15_step4UseShortcut: Use the Undo shortcut! Hold Ctrl and press Z to bring 'Red' back automatically!
l15_step4Reminder: Press Ctrl + Z on your keyboard to bring 'Red' back!
l15_step5: Step 5 of 5: Finally, press Ctrl + S and click SAVE to store your finished note!
l15_done: Outstanding mastery! You aced all Notepad shortcuts and operations!
l16_openPaint:
Level 16: Digital Artist in Paint!
Double-click the Paint icon to open the drawing studio.
l16_openReminder: Double-click quickly on the Paint icon to open it!
l16_drawPrompt: Pick any color from the palette and draw a shape or smile on the canvas using your mouse!
l16_drawReminder: Click and drag your mouse inside the white canvas to draw!
l16_drawDone: Nice drawing! Now let's test undoing a brush stroke.
l16_undoPrompt: Press Ctrl + Z to Undo your last stroke!
l16_holdCtrlZ: Hold down Ctrl and press Z to undo your brush stroke!
l16_undoDone: Stroke undone! You can undo any drawing mistake with Ctrl + Z.
l16_savePrompt: Now press Ctrl + S and confirm in the Save dialog to store your artwork in Pictures!
l16_holdCtrlS: Press Ctrl and S together to save your artwork!
l16_done: Magnificent! You have mastered all mouse, keyboard, and creative tools on the Virtual Desktop!
def_l10_desc:
Learn how to use the desktop Context Menu!
Right-click on the desktop to explore options.
def_l11_desc: Learn how to open Notepad and type phrases on your keyboard!
def_l12_desc:
Learn keyboard shortcuts!
Ctrl + C to copy, Ctrl + V to paste, and Ctrl + X to cut.
def_l13_desc: Learn how to undo mistakes with Ctrl + Z!
def_l14_desc: Learn how to safely save files with Ctrl + S!
def_l15_desc: Complete test: type, copy, cut, undo, and save your document in Notepad!
def_l16_desc: Open Paint, draw artwork, undo with Ctrl + Z, and save with Ctrl + S!
